Absorption Empowerment

Yhwach (Bleach) using Auswählen to take the powers, and life-force, of other Quincy to empower himself or to revive his fallen Sternritter elites.

Power/Ability to:

Be empowered through absorption
"Haw!! No rays can hurt the Absorbin' Man!! I absorb the properties of whatever I touch, so it just makes me as strong as it is!!!"
― Crusher Creel, the Absorbing Man (Marvel Comics)

The power to be empowered by absorption. Combination of Absorption and Affinity. Variation of Absorption Power Link.

Also Called[]

  • Absorption Affinity

Capabilities[]

Users become stronger, faster, more durable, etc. when they absorb a certain object, event, or emotion, possibly unlocking abilities related to the affinity and enhancing the existing powers. Some users may be able to draw sustenance from their affinity or even slow or stop aging.

Gallery[]

Everett "Ej" James/Blaze (Black Sands Entertainment) via Devour can absorb matter & energy to an unlimited degree to empower themselves.
Michael Morningstar/Darkstar (Ben 10 Series) absorb more life energy/mana to be more powerful.
Superman (DC Comics) can absorb solar energy to empower himself.
Android 19 (Dragon Ball Z) can absorb energy, either from Ki attacks...
...or directly from a victim, to power up.
Castiel (Supernatural) became a "god" by empowering himself with the souls of Purgatory.
Famine (Supernatural) consumed souls to regain his strength.
Upon its release after Mark of Cain's removal, the Darkness/Amara (Supernatural) consumed human souls and demons to regain her strength, surviving the combined might of the angels and overpowered Lucifer, an Archangel.
Cell's (Dragon Ball) power increases with each person he absorbs with his tail.
After absorbing his Ghost Chess soldiers, Kapellmeister (Marchen Awakens Romance) was able to transform into a powerful demon form.
Godzilla (Godzilla Heisei series) gained the powerful Red Spiral Ray after absorbing Fire Rodan's life force.
Godzilla (Godzilla, Mothra and King Ghidorah: Giant Monsters All-Out Attack) absorbs King Ghidorah's energy attacks...
...enhancing his Atomic Breath enough to destroy Ghidorah in one hit.
Incubus (DC Extended Universe) become more powerful by absorbing others into his host's body.
